concerns.text: FR-007 requires reporting 'variation in false-positive/negative rates' for a denoising/reconstruction task. FP/FN rates are classification concepts with no defined decision boundary here — the implementer cannot know what counts as a false positive. Rewrite in terms of the actual metrics (e.g., variation in Chamfer Distance / MSE across the k and frequency-threshold sweep, consistent with SC-004).

'Then the system identifies at least one specific eigenmode... that shows a statistically significant correlation (p < 0.05)' demands a positive scientific outcome as an acceptance condition. The Edge Cases section correctly handles the null result, but this scenario as written is unfalsifiable-as-acceptance. Rephrase as a procedure: 'the system performs the correlation analysis and reports all eigenmode–robustness correlations with p-values', with the ≥85%/p<0.05 outcomes living in SC-001/SC-005 as measured hypotheses.
